about: Welcome series for people who get the free Planning Checklist. Sent from the shop Gmail by tools/funnel.mjs. Edit wording here. {first} = first name or 'there'. Every email gets the unsubscribe link and mailing address added automatically.

steps.subject: One gentle step at a time
steps.body:
Hi {first},

Thank you for downloading the planning checklist. If you're planning a service right now, I'm so sorry. You don't have to do everything today.

A few things families tell us help most in the first days:

- Pick one person to keep the list and share it, so nothing is asked twice.
- Choose the date and place first; most other decisions follow from them.
- Gather two or three favorite photos early. You'll want them for the program, a slideshow or a welcome sign.

If it helps, our planning guides walk through the details, like what goes in a funeral program:
https://foreverheld.pages.dev/guides.html

With care,
Josiah, Forever Held

steps.subject: The program, the sign and the memory cards, done tonight
steps.body:
Hi {first},

When it comes to the printed pieces for the service, most families need three things: a program for guests to follow, a welcome sign at the entrance, and cards where people can share a favorite memory.

Our Soft Botanical suite has all three, matching, in gentle sage and cream:

- Funeral program (folds to 5.5 x 8.5 in)
- Welcome sign (24 x 36 in, also prints at 16 x 24 or 12 x 18)
- Share-a-memory cards (four per sheet)

You fill them in on your phone with the free Adobe Acrobat Reader app and print the same day, at home or at a print shop. Nothing to ship, no design skills needed.

See the suite ($12.99, instant download):
https://payhip.com/b/vqNSA

With care,
Josiah, Forever Held

steps.subject: Questions families ask us
steps.body:
Hi {first},

A few questions that come up a lot, in case they help:

How many programs should I print? Usually one per household or couple, plus a few extra as keepsakes.

Can a print shop print the welcome sign? Yes. Ask Staples, Office Depot or FedEx Office to print it at 24 x 36 in on foam board; it's often ready the same day.

Can I add a photo? Yes, on a computer, in Adobe Acrobat Reader.

If you have a question of your own, just reply to this email or write to us here:
https://foreverheld.pages.dev/contact.html

You'll hear from us now and then with gentle seasonal ideas and new designs. If that's not for you, the unsubscribe link is below.

With care,
Josiah, Forever Held
